The ferry leaves the island when there are 10 passengers on the ferry.
In this question, there are already 6 passengers on the ferry.
This means the ferry needs 4 more passengers before it leaves.
Jin wants to model how long the ferry waits at the island before travelling to the mainland.
He assumes the passengers arrive one at a time.
